reproducibility.note: Kaggle uses CPU because the fixed sklearn regressors and 390 rows do not benefit from a GPU; Kaggle is the reproducible execution environment, not an accelerator claim.

acceptance.criteria: at least 10% MAE improvement against the strongest predeclared baseline with the paired period-bootstrap interval excluding zero
